about: One row per inference engine. Everything engine-specific lives here or in engines/<engine>/<version>/mods.json; tools/check.py and the hook read rows and name no engine. A mod is keyed on engine + version + kernel or graph shape, never on a model name. Machine paths (base checkouts, run roots) live in the untracked local.json (see local.example.json).

requires.why: the oldest BoltBeam that reads this index: a consumer that resolves the newest commit of this repo takes the newest one whose index schema it reads and whose requires it meets; raise it when a change needs a newer consumer (a new index field it must read, a mod it must set up). 0.3.30: the rows of a version with modules share one patch (index `module`), which a consumer applies once

rules: one switch per mod; switch off = the engine's stock path. Mods on one extension point share a module: one patch that applies alone on the base
a check mode that runs the stock path beside the mod and aborts on a difference
output bit-identical to stock, or labelled (quality-gated / untested) with the evidence
a line budget per patch (measured size, rounded up a little); over budget fails
gains stated against the same engine's stock build only

git_apply.apply: git apply <patch> in the source tree, patches in series order

patch_p1.apply: patch -p1 --dry-run, then patch -p1, in the installed package folder (site-packages) or a source checkout, patches in series order

1.0.0.why: owner policy 2026-11-24: at most two llama.cpp versions, upstream master as the stock reference plus the latest port; 1.0.0 (b12359) was frozen since 2026-11-19 and is superseded by b12521 and the b12681 port

base_identity.how: git rev-parse HEAD of the base checkout (local.json checkouts) equals base.commit; the touched files have no local changes

switch_kinds.env: environment variable read once with getenv; unset or 0 = off

llama.cpp.off_is_stock: static: every switch literal a patch adds is declared in its row, hunks that remove stock lines are counted against the row; measured: temp-0 text and token counts with the switch off equal the unpatched build (each row's output.evidence)
llama.cpp.tested_tree: source trees that were built and measured (paths are references resolved through local.json roots); mods.json tested_trees lists which patches each holds

base_identity.how: package version from the installed dist-info METADATA; the sha256 of its RECORD (names the exact build) when recorded; every touched file's sha256 equals its RECORD entry (unmodified); the wheel's sha256 when a wheel was kept, else a named SKIP

switch_kinds.none: no switch: applied = on, patch -R -p1 = stock (a recorded rule exception)

vllm.off_is_stock: for a mod without a switch: the patch reverted (patch -R -p1) is stock, checked by the series revert; for a switch: not defined yet
vllm.tested_tree: the patched site-packages a run used; none is on this machine yet

tensorrt-llm.base_identity_note: not defined until its first mod

lint.why: rows and patches name no model (an architecture or graph file may be named as evidence of what exercises a mod), no other engine (gains are against the same engine's stock build only) and no private detail
lint.doc_allow_note: exact lines of README.md, LICENSE or engines/README.md that may match the lint; empty: the license section and the planned-engines line name only engines that have a row here, which the docs lint allows
